svg.title: Pacenotes features
svg.desc: Understand: Symbols, references, call graphs and a token-budgeted repo map. Review: Rule packs and an optional local-AI pass over a diff, with SARIF output. Diagrams that keep your edits: C4, module and sequence diagrams as draw.io files. Serve local AI over MCP: Read-only, with secrets redacted from what it returns.
svg.text: Read a repository the way a maintainer would, without running it.

g.text: Symbols, references, call graphs and a token-budgeted repo
Max retries is now unbounded when policy.max is unset
Rule packs and an optional local-AI pass over a diff, with
C4, module and sequence diagrams as draw.io files.
Read-only, with secrets redacted from what it returns.
